text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Traineeeeer! Did you see that?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: That was the real me—no, the real us!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It's been so long since I got to run so
freely!
choice_data_list: 見違えるようだったよ
choice_data_list_en: You were like a completely different person.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
The responsibility of running for you,
and the
assurance that you're here for
me...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Those two feelings lifted me up and
made me feel
so light...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I was finally able to show you a really
solid run!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: That means I'm okay now, right?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Then can I do the reward thing I wanted
to do
during the Sumire Stakes?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The time has finally come—on this grand
stage, in
front of everyone!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Who's a good trainer?! You are! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I've finally become the

Umamusume I've always wanted to be.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for making you wait... And thank
you for
being so patient.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm so proud of you and how capable
you've
become.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We've learned so much together—things
that will
make us the best of the best.
choice_data_list: こちらこそ育ててくれて、ありがとう！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure Super Creek now has what it
takes to
race among the seniors in the
Grand Prix too!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: So, what should our next goal be?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Nakayama?!
choice_data_list: 年末の中山にしようか
choice_data_list_en: Shall we aim for Nakayama at the end of the year?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Okay. I'm a little scared, but I want to
face this
challenge with you.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Let's take on the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Phew. What took ya? Been waitin'
forever to see
those skills!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Now we've finally got a superstar lineup
for the
year-end race.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You'll be facin' the best senior racer
around, and
the uncrowned Classic
champion.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Right, Oguri?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: That's right...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I'm starving...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Gah! You're completely off topic!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek's rivals have their sights set
squarely
on her.
